"""Within-image CFA sample split on retained mesh RAW; no RGB restoration."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import resource
import shutil
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import psutil
from green_phase_spectrum import tapered_spectrum
from phase_frequency_holdout import describe_phase_holdout

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
ROOT = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V177-phase-frequency-holdout-v1"
EXTERNAL = Path("/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/V177-phase-frequency-holdout-v1")


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    path = Path(path).absolute()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest}


def save(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


def fingerprint(array):
    return {
        "shape": list(array.shape),
        "dtype": array.dtype.str,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(np.ascontiguousarray(array).tobytes()).hexdigest(),
    }


def sample_RGB(rgb, colors):
    return np.stack(
        [
            np.stack([image[int(color), p // 2 :: 2, p % 2 :: 2] for p, color in enumerate(layout)])
            for image, layout in zip(rgb, colors, strict=True)
        ]
    )


def prepare():
    assert not ROOT.exists() and not EXTERNAL.exists()
    prior_path = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V176-template-information-v1/plan-v1.json"
    prior = read(prior_path)
    assert ref(prior["source_cache"]["path"]) == prior["source_cache"]
    sources = [Path(__file__).absolute()] + [
        REPO / name
        for name in [
            "scripts/phase_frequency_holdout.py",
            "scripts/green_phase_spectrum.py",
            "tests/test_phase_frequency_holdout.py",
            "tests/test_green_phase_spectrum.py",
        ]
    ]
    tests = REPO / ".cache/v177-phase-frequency-CPU-tests-v2.log"
    assert "33 passed" in tests.read_text() and "failed" not in tests.read_text()
    assert shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > (48 + 0.5 + 0.4 + 0.05) * 2**30
    assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > (111 + 0.5 + 1.25 + 0.1) * 2**30
    ROOT.mkdir()
    EXTERNAL.mkdir()
    save(
        ROOT / "plan-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "fixed-one-green-phase-selection-other-phase-measurement",
            "created_unix_UTC": time.time(),
            "prior_template_plan": ref(prior_path),
            "source_cache": prior["source_cache"],
            "selected_steps": prior["selected_steps"],
            "batches": 307,
            "pairs": 614,
            "observations": 1228,
            "directions_per_observation": 2,
            "peaks_per_direction": 4,
            "descriptive_other_power_edges": [1, 4, 16, 64],
            "frequency_band": "Principal packed band mapped to native radial1/16..1/3 cycles/pixel;one conjugate half-plane. Suppress3x3 neighbors/conjugates per selection direction.",
            "selection": "A-phase abs(Hann/affine-residual unitary FFT)^2/propagated supplied A variance only. No B values,clean target,template,parent or model output in that direction's bins/rank/power. B is measured at fixed A-selected bins. Both directions run separately;combining their results reuses both phases.",
            "phase_alignment": "Signed agreement after principal-band CFA position compensation;native aliases can reverse sign or make a carrier vanish in one phase. No automatic rejection by signed agreement.",
            "variance": "Input statistics use supplied noisy-intensity physical variance proxy. Post-selection scoring separately uses exact clean shot*x+read pre-ADC variance;no calibrated probability or Gaussian/real-sensor independence claim.",
            "target_access": "All4 observations' input-only selections are durably journaled per batch before target/pair_indices arrays are read. Full source npz hash verifies bytes without interpreting target values.",
            "sources": [dict(ref(p), text=p.read_text()) for p in sources],
            "CPU_tests": dict(ref(tests), text=tests.read_text()),
            "new_local_projection_GiB": 0.05,
            "new_external_projection_GiB": 0.1,
            "scope": "All retained noisy mesh training observations only;within-image CFA sample split,not held-out-image validation. Uses1228 member RAW observations separately,never coupled noisy differences. No restoration,model/checkpoint load,neural,parent/DINO,sampler,noise draw,source render,RAW decoder,real-media/original/dataz read or V175 recipe change. GT enters descriptive scoring only after fixed input selections. No threshold tuning,confidence calibration,model promotion or flat-safety claim. Future models still require independent quality and native comparisons.",
        },
    )
    print("Prepared307batches1228observations9824selectedpeaks", flush=True)


def execute(plan_path):
    plan = read(plan_path)
    assert not (EXTERNAL / "result-v1.json").exists()
    (ROOT / "run.claim").open("x").close()
    for binding in plan["sources"]:
        assert ref(binding["path"])["sha256"] == binding["sha256"]
        assert Path(binding["path"]).read_text() == binding["text"]
    assert ref(plan["source_cache"]["path"]) == plan["source_cache"]
    os.nice(10)
    os.sched_setaffinity(0, [4, 5])
    owner = {"pid": os.getpid(), "created": psutil.Process().create_time()}
    save(ROOT / "owner-v1.json", owner)
    cache = read(plan["source_cache"]["path"])
    selected = set(plan["selected_steps"])
    batches = [r for r in cache["batches"] if r["step"] in selected]
    assert len(batches) == 307
    rows = []
    checked = 0
    with (
        (EXTERNAL / "input-only-selections-v1.jsonl").open("x") as selections,
        (EXTERNAL / "scored-rows-v1.jsonl").open("x") as scored,
    ):
        for number, item in enumerate(batches, 1):
            assert psutil.virtual_memory().available > 32 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage(REPO).free > 48 * 2**30
            assert shutil.disk_usage("/mnt/external").free > (111 + 0.5 + 1.25) * 2**30
            assert ref(item["arrays"]["path"]) == item["arrays"]
            with np.load(item["arrays"]["path"], allow_pickle=False) as source:
                inputs = {key: source[key] for key in ["packed", "variance", "colors"]}
                for key, value in inputs.items():
                    assert fingerprint(value) == item["inputs"][key]
                    checked += 1
                observation_selections = [
                    describe_phase_holdout(raw, variance, colors, count=plan["peaks_per_direction"])
                    for raw, variance, colors in zip(
                        inputs["packed"], inputs["variance"], inputs["colors"], strict=True
                    )
                ]
                assert len(observation_selections) == 4
                selection_record = {
                    "step": item["step"],
                    "original_inputs": item["arrays"],
                    "observations": observation_selections,
                }
                selections.write(json.dumps(selection_record, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                selections.flush()
                os.fsync(selections.fileno())
                # Target/pair interpretation starts only after this durable input-only record.
                target, pairs = source["target"], source["pair_indices"]
                for key, value in [("target", target), ("pair_indices", pairs)]:
                    assert fingerprint(value) == item["inputs"][key]
                    checked += 1
                clean = sample_RGB(np.maximum(target, np.float32(0)), inputs["colors"])
                first, second = pairs.T
                assert fingerprint(clean[first]) == item["metadata"]["sensor"]["clean_packed_a"]
                assert fingerprint(clean[second]) == item["metadata"]["sensor"]["clean_packed_b"]
                shot, read_noise = [item["metadata"]["noise"][k] for k in ["shot", "read"]]
                for pair_index, (present, absent) in enumerate(pairs):
                    signal = clean[present].astype(np.float64) - clean[absent].astype(np.float64)
                    for member, index in [("present", int(present)), ("absent", int(absent))]:
                        directions = []
                        for direction in observation_selections[index]:
                            a, b = direction["selection_phase"], direction["other_phase"]
                            actual_a = shot * clean[index, a].astype(np.float64) + read_noise
                            actual_b = shot * clean[index, b].astype(np.float64) + read_noise
                            reference_a = tapered_spectrum(clean[index, a], actual_a)
                            reference_b = tapered_spectrum(clean[index, b], actual_b)
                            template_b = tapered_spectrum(signal[b])["spectrum"]
                            peaks = []
                            for peak in direction["peaks"]:
                                y, x = peak["bin_yx"]
                                va = float(reference_a["noise_variance"][y, x])
                                vb = float(reference_b["noise_variance"][y, x])
                                peaks.append(
                                    dict(
                                        peak,
                                        clean_selection_power=float(
                                            abs(reference_a["spectrum"][y, x]) ** 2 / va
                                        ),
                                        clean_other_power=float(
                                            abs(reference_b["spectrum"][y, x]) ** 2 / vb
                                        ),
                                        hidden_template_other_power=float(
                                            abs(template_b[y, x]) ** 2 / vb
                                        ),
                                        other_proxy_over_actual_variance=peak[
                                            "other_noise_variance"
                                        ]
                                        / vb,
                                    )
                                )
                            directions.append(
                                {"selection_phase": a, "other_phase": b, "peaks": peaks}
                            )
                        row = {
                            "step": item["step"],
                            "pair": pair_index,
                            "member": member,
                            "frame_index": index,
                            "original_inputs": item["arrays"],
                            "fine_ladder": item["metadata"].get("training_distribution")
                            == "fine-mesh-ladder-v1",
                            "directions": directions,
                        }
                        scored.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                        scored.flush()
                        rows.append(row)
            if number % 25 == 0:
                print(
                    json.dumps(
                        {
                            "batches": number,
                            "observations": len(rows),
                            "RSS": psutil.Process().memory_info().rss,
                        }
                    ),
                    flush=True,
                )
    assert checked == 1535 and len(rows) == 1228
    assert sum(len(d["peaks"]) for r in rows for d in r["directions"]) == 9824
    save(
        EXTERNAL / "result-v1.json",
        {
            "status": "completed-all1228-input-only-selections-followed-by-GT-scoring",
            "owner": owner,
            "plan": ref(plan_path),
            "rows": rows,
            "input_selection_journal": ref(EXTERNAL / "input-only-selections-v1.jsonl"),
            "scored_journal": ref(EXTERNAL / "scored-rows-v1.jsonl"),
            "input_array_fingerprints_checked": checked,
            "npz_files_hashed": 307,
            "selected_peaks": 9824,
            "new_neural_forwards": 0,
            "new_parent_DINO_forwards": 0,
            "new_source_renders": 0,
            "new_noise_draws": 0,
            "new_checkpoint_loads": 0,
            "Torch_imported": "torch" in sys.modules,
            "RAW_decoder_imported": "rawpy" in sys.modules,
            "peak_RSS_bytes": resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss * 1024,
            "scope": plan["scope"],
        },
    )
    print("Completed1228observations9824peaks;no restoration", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("phase", choices=["prepare", "run"])
    parser.add_argument("--plan", type=Path, default=ROOT / "plan-v1.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    prepare() if args.phase == "prepare" else execute(args.plan)

"""Select frequencies in one green CFA phase and describe the other phase.

This within-image sample split is not an unseen-image validation set. Supplied
noisy variance proxies and fitted nuisance affect the statistics; no threshold
is calibrated here. The principal packed band has unresolved native aliases.
"""

import numpy as np
from green_phase_spectrum import tapered_spectrum


def select_phase_frequencies(spectrum, noise_variance, *, count=4):
    """Rank one phase only, suppressing nearby/conjugate bins after each pick."""
    spectrum = np.asarray(spectrum)
    noise_variance = np.asarray(noise_variance)
    if (
        spectrum.ndim != 2
        or noise_variance.shape != spectrum.shape
        or not np.isfinite(spectrum).all()
        or not np.isfinite(noise_variance).all()
        or (noise_variance <= 0).any()
        or not isinstance(count, int)
        or count < 1
    ):
        raise ValueError("Require finite 2D spectrum, positive matching variance and count")
    height, width = spectrum.shape
    fy = np.fft.fftfreq(height)[:, None] / 2
    fx = np.fft.fftfreq(width)[None, :] / 2
    radius = np.hypot(fy, fx)
    available = (radius >= 1 / 16) & (radius <= 1 / 3)
    available &= (fy > 0) | ((fy == 0) & (fx > 0))
    power = np.abs(spectrum) ** 2 / noise_variance
    selected = []
    for _ in range(count):
        score = np.where(available, power, -np.inf)
        flat = int(np.argmax(score))
        if not np.isfinite(score.ravel()[flat]):
            break
        y, x = np.unravel_index(flat, score.shape)
        selected.append((int(y), int(x)))
        for cy, cx in [(y, x), ((-y) % height, (-x) % width)]:
            for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                    available[(cy + dy) % height, (cx + dx) % width] = False
    return selected


def describe_phase_holdout(packed, variance, colors, *, count=4):
    """Both directions of one-phase selection followed by other-phase measurement.

    Each direction's bins depend on its selection phase only. Descriptive power
    and signed principal-band phase agreement in the other phase do not affect
    that selection. Separate physical sensor samples can have independent noise
    under the synthetic model; real-camera independence is not established.
    """
    packed = np.asarray(packed, dtype=np.float64)
    variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
    colors = np.asarray(colors)
    allowed = {(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)}
    if (
        packed.ndim != 3
        or packed.shape[0] != 4
        or variance.shape != packed.shape
        or colors.shape != (4,)
        or tuple(colors) not in allowed
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected matching 4xHxW RAW/variance and standard Bayer colors")
    green = np.flatnonzero(colors == 1)
    phases = {int(i): tapered_spectrum(packed[i], variance[i]) for i in green}
    fy = np.fft.fftfreq(packed.shape[-2]) / 2
    fx = np.fft.fftfreq(packed.shape[-1]) / 2
    output = []
    for a, b in [(int(green[0]), int(green[1])), (int(green[1]), int(green[0]))]:
        selection, held = phases[a], phases[b]
        ay, ax = divmod(a, 2)
        by, bx = divmod(b, 2)
        peaks = []
        for y, x in select_phase_frequencies(
            selection["spectrum"], selection["noise_variance"], count=count
        ):
            first, second = selection["spectrum"][y, x], held["spectrum"][y, x]
            first_noise = float(selection["noise_variance"][y, x])
            second_noise = float(held["noise_variance"][y, x])
            if second_noise <= 0:
                raise ValueError("Other-phase propagated variance must be positive")
            alignment = np.exp(2j * np.pi * ((by - ay) * fy[y] + (bx - ax) * fx[x]))
            product = first * np.conj(second) * alignment
            amplitude_product = abs(first) * abs(second)
            peaks.append(
                {
                    "bin_yx": [y, x],
                    "principal_native_fxy": [float(fx[x]), float(fy[y])],
                    "selection_power": float(abs(first) ** 2 / first_noise),
                    "other_phase_power": float(abs(second) ** 2 / second_noise),
                    "signed_principal_phase_agreement": (
                        float(np.real(product) / amplitude_product)
                        if amplitude_product > 0
                        else 0.0
                    ),
                    "selection_noise_variance": first_noise,
                    "other_noise_variance": second_noise,
                }
            )
        output.append({"selection_phase": a, "other_phase": b, "peaks": peaks})
    return output

"""NumPy diagnostics of separately measured green CFA planes, not restoration.

Phase compensation describes the principal packed-grid band. Aliases can reverse
the signed cross-spectrum; a four-native-pixel carrier can even vanish in one
green phase. Agreement is therefore neither an all-frequency signal detector
nor a calibrated photographic confidence measure.
"""

import numpy as np


def _geometry(shape):
    height, width = shape
    if min(shape) < 8:
        raise ValueError("Spectral fields need at least eight samples per axis")
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.linspace(-1, 1, height), np.linspace(-1, 1, width), indexing="ij")
    basis = np.stack((np.ones(shape), x, y), axis=-1)
    window = np.hanning(height)[:, None] * np.hanning(width)[None, :]
    gram = np.einsum("hwi,hwj,hw->ij", basis, basis, window**2)
    return basis, window, np.linalg.inv(gram)


def tapered_spectrum(image, variance=None):
    """Hann-taper a weighted-plane residual and propagate independent noise.

    For Q=[1,x,y], W=diag(Hann), beta=(Q'W²Q)^-1 Q'W²image.
    The Fourier operator is F W (I-Q(Q'W²Q)^-1 Q'W²). Its per-coefficient
    noise variance includes the fitted-plane terms, not just mean input noise.
    This is conditional linear propagation for supplied independent variances;
    observed-signal variance proxies are not established camera-noise truth.
    """
    image = np.asarray(image, dtype=np.float64)
    if image.ndim != 2 or not np.isfinite(image).all():
        raise ValueError("Expected one finite real image plane")
    basis, window, inverse = _geometry(image.shape)
    beta = inverse @ np.einsum("hwi,hw,hw->i", basis, window**2, image)
    residual = window * (image - np.einsum("hwi,i->hw", basis, beta))
    spectrum = np.fft.fft2(residual, norm="ortho")
    noise = None
    if variance is not None:
        variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
        if variance.shape != image.shape or not np.isfinite(variance).all() or (variance < 0).any():
            raise ValueError("Variance must be finite, nonnegative and match the image")
        # t_k = a_k - h_k (W² Q)', with a_k the tapered Fourier row.
        transformed_basis = np.fft.fft2(window[..., None] * basis, axes=(0, 1), norm="ortho")
        h = transformed_basis @ inverse
        cross = np.fft.fft2((variance * window**3)[..., None] * basis, axes=(0, 1), norm="ortho")
        covariance = np.einsum("hwi,hwj,hw->ij", basis, basis, variance * window**4)
        base = float(np.mean(variance * window**2))
        noise = (
            base
            - 2 * np.real(np.sum(np.conj(h) * cross, axis=-1))
            + np.real(np.einsum("hwi,ij,hwj->hw", h, covariance, np.conj(h)))
        )
        if np.min(noise) < -1e-10 * max(base, np.finfo(np.float64).tiny):
            raise ArithmeticError("Propagated spectral noise variance became negative")
        noise = np.maximum(noise, 0)
    return {"spectrum": spectrum, "noise_variance": noise, "plane": beta}


def _average3(values):
    return sum(np.roll(values, (y, x), axis=(0, 1)) for y in (-1, 0, 1) for x in (-1, 0, 1)) / 9


def green_pair(packed, variance, colors):
    """Describe both greens on an even-origin four-phase packed RAW field.

    The 3×3 frequency average is not nine independent observations. Its signed
    coherence is bounded by Cauchy-Schwarz, but is not a test probability.
    Noise-normalized cross power has no calibrated false-discovery threshold.
    """
    packed = np.asarray(packed, dtype=np.float64)
    variance = np.asarray(variance, dtype=np.float64)
    colors = np.asarray(colors)
    allowed = {(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)}
    if (
        packed.ndim != 3
        or packed.shape[0] != 4
        or variance.shape != packed.shape
        or colors.shape != (4,)
        or tuple(colors) not in allowed
    ):
        raise ValueError("Expected matching 4×H×W RAW/variance and a standard Bayer layout")
    indices = np.flatnonzero(colors == 1)
    first, second = [tapered_spectrum(packed[i], variance[i]) for i in indices]
    height, width = packed.shape[-2:]
    fy = np.fft.fftfreq(height)[:, None] / 2
    fx = np.fft.fftfreq(width)[None, :] / 2
    y0, x0 = divmod(int(indices[0]), 2)
    y1, x1 = divmod(int(indices[1]), 2)
    alignment = np.exp(2j * np.pi * ((y1 - y0) * fy + (x1 - x0) * fx))
    cross = first["spectrum"] * np.conj(second["spectrum"]) * alignment
    power = np.stack([np.abs(item["spectrum"]) ** 2 for item in (first, second)])
    averaged_cross = _average3(cross)
    averaged_power = np.stack([_average3(p) for p in power])
    denominator = np.sqrt(averaged_power[0] * averaged_power[1])
    coherence = np.divide(
        averaged_cross,
        denominator,
        out=np.zeros_like(averaged_cross),
        where=denominator > np.finfo(np.float64).tiny,
    )
    if np.max(np.abs(coherence)) > 1 + 1e-12:
        raise ArithmeticError("Smoothed cross-spectrum violates Cauchy-Schwarz")
    noise = np.stack([item["noise_variance"] for item in (first, second)])
    averaged_noise = np.stack([_average3(v) for v in noise])
    scale = np.sqrt(averaged_noise[0] * averaged_noise[1])
    normalized_cross = None
    normalized_power = None
    if np.all(scale > 0) and np.all(averaged_noise > 0):
        normalized_cross = np.real(averaged_cross) / scale
        normalized_power = np.mean(averaged_power / averaged_noise, axis=0)
    return {
        "green_phase_indices": indices,
        "spectra": np.stack([first["spectrum"], second["spectrum"]]),
        "noise_variance": noise,
        "power": power,
        "aligned_cross": cross,
        "average_cross": averaged_cross,
        "signed_coherence": np.real(coherence),
        "complex_coherence": coherence,
        "noise_units_signed_cross": normalized_cross,
        "noise_units_mean_phase_power": normalized_power,
        "native_fx": np.broadcast_to(fx, (height, width)).copy(),
        "native_fy": np.broadcast_to(fy, (height, width)).copy(),
        "removed_planes": np.stack([first["plane"], second["plane"]]),
    }


def cross_decomposition(packed, reference, variance, colors):
    """Separate reference, residual and mixed terms in observed green cross-power.

    This is an algebraic diagnostic, not an independence or unbiasedness claim.
    The residual can include added noise, ADC quantization/clipping and reference
    mismatch. A low-noise camera estimate must not be called noiseless GT.
    """
    observed = green_pair(packed, variance, colors)
    target = green_pair(reference, variance, colors)
    if np.shape(reference) != np.shape(packed):
        raise ValueError("Reference must match packed observation geometry")
    signal = target["spectra"]
    residual = observed["spectra"] - signal
    first, second = observed["green_phase_indices"]
    y0, x0 = divmod(int(first), 2)
    y1, x1 = divmod(int(second), 2)
    alignment = np.exp(
        2j * np.pi * ((y1 - y0) * observed["native_fy"] + (x1 - x0) * observed["native_fx"])
    )
    products = {
        "reference": signal[0] * np.conj(signal[1]),
        "residual": residual[0] * np.conj(residual[1]),
        "mixed": signal[0] * np.conj(residual[1]) + residual[0] * np.conj(signal[1]),
    }
    cross = {name: _average3(value * alignment) for name, value in products.items()}
    total = sum(cross.values())
    scale = max(float(np.max(np.abs(observed["average_cross"]))), np.finfo(float).tiny)
    if np.max(np.abs(total - observed["average_cross"])) > 64 * np.finfo(float).eps * scale:
        raise ArithmeticError("Reference/residual/mixed cross-power identity failed")
    noise_scale = np.sqrt(
        np.prod(np.stack([_average3(v) for v in observed["noise_variance"]]), axis=0)
    )
    normalized = None
    if np.all(noise_scale > 0):
        normalized = {name: value.real / noise_scale for name, value in cross.items()}
    return {
        "observed": observed,
        "reference": target,
        "component_cross": cross,
        "noise_units_components": normalized,
    }

"""Check phase separation, exact deterministic geometry and noise propagation."""

import numpy as np
import pytest
from green_phase_spectrum import tapered_spectrum
from phase_frequency_holdout import describe_phase_holdout, select_phase_frequencies


def fixture(layout=(0, 1, 1, 2)):
    n = 32
    y, x = np.indices((n, n))
    packed = np.stack(
        [
            0.02
            + 0.001
            * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (5 * (2 * x + i % 2) + 7 * (2 * y + i // 2)) / (2 * n) + 0.3)
            for i in range(4)
        ]
    )
    variance = np.full_like(packed, 1e-6)
    return packed, variance, np.array(layout)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("layout", [(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)])
def test_native_phase_compensation(layout):
    packed, variance, colors = fixture(layout)
    outputs = describe_phase_holdout(packed, variance, colors)
    for direction in outputs:
        peak = direction["peaks"][0]
        assert peak["bin_yx"] == [7, 5]
        assert peak["signed_principal_phase_agreement"] == pytest.approx(1, abs=2e-5)


def test_other_phase_cannot_change_selection():
    packed, variance, colors = fixture()
    before = describe_phase_holdout(packed, variance, colors)
    # Change the measured phase and its variance, preserving selection phase1.
    y, x = np.indices((32, 32))
    changed = packed.copy()
    changed[2] = 0.03 + 0.2 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (11 * x + 3 * y) / 32)
    noise = variance.copy()
    noise[2] *= 123
    after = describe_phase_holdout(changed, noise, colors)
    assert before[0]["selection_phase"] == after[0]["selection_phase"] == 1
    assert [p["bin_yx"] for p in before[0]["peaks"]] == [p["bin_yx"] for p in after[0]["peaks"]]
    assert [p["selection_power"] for p in before[0]["peaks"]] == [
        p["selection_power"] for p in after[0]["peaks"]
    ]
    assert before[0]["peaks"][0]["other_phase_power"] != after[0]["peaks"][0]["other_phase_power"]
    assert before[1]["peaks"][0]["bin_yx"] != after[1]["peaks"][0]["bin_yx"]


def test_affine_background_invariance():
    packed, variance, colors = fixture()
    y, x = np.indices((32, 32))
    before = describe_phase_holdout(packed, variance, colors)
    after = describe_phase_holdout(packed + 0.4 + 0.01 * x - 0.02 * y, variance, colors)
    for a, b in zip(before, after, strict=True):
        assert [p["bin_yx"] for p in a["peaks"]] == [p["bin_yx"] for p in b["peaks"]]
        np.testing.assert_allclose(
            [p["other_phase_power"] for p in a["peaks"]],
            [p["other_phase_power"] for p in b["peaks"]],
            rtol=2e-9,
        )


def test_frequency_order_matches_direct_linear_rows():
    packed, variance, _ = fixture()
    image = packed[1]
    result = tapered_spectrum(image, variance[1])
    for y, x in select_phase_frequencies(result["spectrum"], result["noise_variance"]):
        n = image.shape[0]
        yy, xx = np.indices(image.shape)
        basis = np.stack([np.ones(image.size), xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()], axis=1)
        window = np.outer(np.hanning(n), np.hanning(n)).ravel()
        # Independently form one complete fitted-plane Fourier row.
        fourier = window * np.exp(-2j * np.pi * (x * xx.ravel() + y * yy.ravel()) / n) / n
        plane_operator = np.linalg.solve(
            basis.T @ (window[:, None] ** 2 * basis), basis.T * window**2
        )
        row = fourier - (fourier @ basis) @ plane_operator
        np.testing.assert_allclose(result["spectrum"][y, x], row @ image.ravel(), atol=1e-16)
        assert result["noise_variance"][y, x] == pytest.approx(
            np.sum(abs(row) ** 2 * variance[1].ravel()), rel=1e-12
        )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ["zero-variance", "nan", "bad-layout", "bad-shape"])
def test_invalid_contract(case):
    packed, variance, colors = fixture()
    if case == "zero-variance":
        variance[:] = 0
    elif case == "nan":
        packed[0, 0, 0] = np.nan
        packed[1, 0, 0] = np.nan
    elif case == "bad-layout":
        colors[:] = 1
    else:
        packed = packed[:3]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        describe_phase_holdout(packed, variance, colors)

import numpy as np
import pytest
from green_phase_spectrum import cross_decomposition, green_pair, tapered_spectrum

PATTERNS = [(0, 1, 1, 2), (2, 1, 1, 0), (1, 0, 2, 1), (1, 2, 0, 1)]


def packed_field(image):
    return np.stack([image[y::2, x::2] for y, x in ((0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1))])


def test_weighted_plane_and_noise_match_independent_dense_complex_DFT():
    height, width = 8, 10
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(height), np.arange(width), indexing="ij")
    image = 0.18 + 0.01 * np.cos(x * 1.3 + y * 0.6) + 0.004 * x**2
    variance = 1e-4 * (1 + 0.4 * np.sin(x + y))
    before = image.copy(), variance.copy()
    q = np.stack([np.ones_like(x), 2 * x / (width - 1) - 1, 2 * y / (height - 1) - 1], -1).reshape(
        -1, 3
    )
    w = (np.hanning(height)[:, None] * np.hanning(width)[None, :]).ravel()
    f = np.exp(
        -2j
        * np.pi
        * (
            y.ravel()[:, None] * y.ravel()[None] / height
            + x.ravel()[:, None] * x.ravel()[None] / width
        )
    ) / np.sqrt(height * width)
    fit = q @ np.linalg.solve(q.T @ ((w * w)[:, None] * q), q.T * (w * w)[None])
    operator = f @ (w[:, None] * (np.eye(height * width) - fit))
    expected = operator @ image.ravel()
    noise = np.abs(operator) ** 2 @ variance.ravel()
    actual = tapered_spectrum(image, variance)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual["spectrum"].ravel(), expected, atol=4e-15, rtol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual["noise_variance"].ravel(), noise, atol=1e-18, rtol=1e-12)
    assert np.array_equal(before[0], image) and np.array_equal(before[1], variance)


def test_affine_field_removed_without_clipping_and_zero_noise_has_no_normalized_statistic():
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(32), np.arange(40), indexing="ij")
    image = -0.01 + 0.03 * x - 0.05 * y
    result = tapered_spectrum(image, np.zeros_like(image))
    # The plane fit and unitary FFT should leave only normwise FP64 roundoff.
    assert np.linalg.norm(result["spectrum"]) < 8 * np.finfo(float).eps * np.linalg.norm(image)
    pair = green_pair(packed_field(image), np.zeros((4, 16, 20)), PATTERNS[0])
    assert pair["noise_units_signed_cross"] is None
    assert pair["noise_units_mean_phase_power"] is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", PATTERNS)
def test_subpixel_phase_compensation_resolves_low_frequency_carrier(pattern):
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(128), np.arange(160), indexing="ij")
    image = 0.18 + 0.0036 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (5 * x / 160 + 3 * y / 128) + 0.4)
    packed = packed_field(image)
    result = green_pair(packed, np.full_like(packed, 1e-5), pattern)
    assert result["signed_coherence"][3, 5] > 0.998
    assert result["noise_units_signed_cross"][3, 5] > 1
    assert np.max(np.abs(result["complex_coherence"])) <= 1 + 1e-12


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", PATTERNS)
def test_above_phase_Nyquist_signal_can_have_negative_aligned_cross_power(pattern):
    _y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(128), np.arange(160), indexing="ij")
    image = 0.18 + 0.0036 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * 3 * x / 8 + 0.4)
    packed = packed_field(image)
    result = green_pair(packed, np.full_like(packed, 1e-5), pattern)
    assert result["signed_coherence"][0, 20] < -0.998
    assert result["noise_units_signed_cross"][0, 20] < -1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", PATTERNS)
def test_four_pixel_carrier_can_vanish_in_one_measured_green_phase(pattern):
    _y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(128), np.arange(160), indexing="ij")
    image = 0.18 + 0.0036 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * x / 4)
    packed = packed_field(image)
    result = green_pair(packed, np.full_like(packed, 1e-5), pattern)
    strengths = result["power"][:, 0, 40]
    assert strengths.min() < 1e-24 and strengths.max() > 0.001
    assert abs(result["noise_units_signed_cross"][0, 40]) < 1e-8


@pytest.mark.parametrize("damage", ["negative_variance", "nonfinite", "non_bayer"])
def test_invalid_inputs_rejected(damage):
    packed, variance, colors = np.ones((4, 16, 20)), np.ones((4, 16, 20)), PATTERNS[0]
    if damage == "negative_variance":
        variance[1, 0, 0] = -1
    elif damage == "nonfinite":
        packed[1, 0, 0] = np.nan
    else:
        colors = (0, 0, 1, 2)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        green_pair(packed, variance, colors)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("pattern", PATTERNS)
def test_reference_residual_mixed_split_keeps_cancellation_and_negative_terms(pattern):
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(32), np.arange(40), indexing="ij")
    reference = packed_field(0.18 + 0.01 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * (3 * x / 40 + 2 * y / 32)))
    # A deterministic algebra fixture: observed contrast is reduced by half.
    observed = 0.18 + 0.5 * (reference - 0.18)
    before = reference.copy(), observed.copy()
    result = cross_decomposition(observed, reference, np.full_like(reference, 1e-4), pattern)
    parts = result["component_cross"]
    np.testing.assert_allclose(parts["residual"], 0.25 * parts["reference"], atol=1e-17)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(parts["mixed"], -parts["reference"], atol=1e-17)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sum(parts.values()), result["observed"]["average_cross"], atol=1e-17)
    assert np.min(parts["mixed"].real) < 0
    assert np.array_equal(reference, before[0]) and np.array_equal(observed, before[1])


def test_reference_residual_split_has_zero_residual_for_identical_fields():
    y, x = np.meshgrid(np.arange(32), np.arange(40), indexing="ij")
    field = packed_field(0.18 + 0.01 * np.cos(2 * np.pi * x / 8 + y))
    result = cross_decomposition(field, field, np.zeros_like(field), PATTERNS[0])
    assert np.array_equal(result["component_cross"]["residual"], np.zeros((16, 20)))
    assert np.array_equal(result["component_cross"]["mixed"], np.zeros((16, 20)))
    assert result["noise_units_components"] is None

"""Independent QR/FFT selection and all journal/result bindings; no restoration."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

REPO=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic')
ROOT=REPO/'.cache/quality-20261107/V177-phase-frequency-holdout-v1'
EXTERNAL=Path('/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/V177-phase-frequency-holdout-v1')

def read(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def ref(p):
 p=Path(p).absolute()
 with p.open('rb') as f:digest=hashlib.file_digest(f,'sha256').hexdigest()
 return {'path':str(p),'sha256':digest}

def independent_spectrum(image,variance):
 height,width=image.shape
 y,x=np.indices(image.shape)
 q=np.column_stack([np.ones(image.size),x.ravel(),y.ravel()])
 window=np.outer(np.hanning(height),np.hanning(width)).ravel()
 u,_=np.linalg.qr(q*window[:,None],mode='reduced')
 weighted=image.ravel()*window
 residual=weighted-u@(u.T@weighted)
 spectrum=np.fft.fft2(residual.reshape(image.shape),norm='ortho')
 # Independent orthonormal projection form of full Fourier-row variance.
 h=np.fft.fft2(u.reshape(height,width,3),axes=(0,1),norm='ortho')
 diagonal=variance.ravel()*window**2
 cross=np.fft.fft2((u*diagonal[:,None]).reshape(height,width,3),axes=(0,1),norm='ortho')
 covariance=u.T@(diagonal[:,None]*u)
 noise=(diagonal.sum()/image.size-2*np.real((h.conj()*cross).sum(-1))+
        np.real(np.einsum('hwi,ij,hwj->hw',h,covariance,h.conj())))
 return spectrum,noise,u,window

def independent_bins(spectrum,noise):
 height,width=spectrum.shape
 fy=np.fft.fftfreq(height)[:,None]/2;fx=np.fft.fftfreq(width)[None,:]/2
 mask=(np.hypot(fy,fx)>=1/16)&(np.hypot(fy,fx)<=1/3)&((fy>0)|((fy==0)&(fx>0)))
 values=abs(spectrum)**2/noise
 # Sorting once and filtering accepted neighborhoods is distinct from repeated argmax.
 order=np.argsort(values.ravel(),kind='stable')[::-1]
 chosen=[]
 for flat in order:
  y,x=np.unravel_index(flat,values.shape)
  if not mask[y,x]:continue
  chosen.append([int(y),int(x)])
  for cy,cx in [(y,x),((-y)%height,(-x)%width)]:
   for dy in [-1,0,1]:
    for dx in [-1,0,1]:mask[(cy+dy)%height,(cx+dx)%width]=False
  if len(chosen)==4:break
 return chosen

plan_path=ROOT/'plan-v2.json';plan=read(plan_path)
assert not (ROOT/'independent-verification-v1.json').exists()
result=read(EXTERNAL/'result-v1.json')
assert result['plan']==ref(plan_path)
for binding in plan['sources']:
 assert ref(binding['path'])['sha256']==binding['sha256']
 assert Path(binding['path']).read_text()==binding['text']
selection_rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (EXTERNAL/'input-only-selections-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
scored_rows=[json.loads(line) for line in (EXTERNAL/'scored-rows-v1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
assert scored_rows==result['rows'] and len(scored_rows)==1228 and len(selection_rows)==307
by_step={r['step']:r for r in selection_rows}
all_peaks=0
for row in scored_rows:
 original=by_step[row['step']]['observations'][row['frame_index']]
 assert row['original_inputs']==by_step[row['step']]['original_inputs']
 for direction,selected in zip(row['directions'],original,strict=True):
  assert direction['selection_phase']==selected['selection_phase']
  assert direction['other_phase']==selected['other_phase']
  for peak,input_peak in zip(direction['peaks'],selected['peaks'],strict=True):
   assert {k:peak[k] for k in input_peak}==input_peak
   assert len(peak['bin_yx'])==2 and peak['other_proxy_over_actual_variance']>0
   all_peaks+=1
assert all_peaks==9824
max_difference=0.;bins_checked=scalar_checks=direct_row_checks=0
def compare(expected,actual):
 global max_difference,scalar_checks
 difference=float(abs(expected-actual)/max(1,abs(expected),abs(actual)))
 max_difference=max(max_difference,difference);scalar_checks+=1
 assert difference<2e-10,(expected,actual,difference)

# Fixed first12 batches, selected before this verifier reads any outcome.
for record in selection_rows[:12]:
 path=Path(record['original_inputs']['path'])
 assert ref(path)==record['original_inputs']
 with np.load(path,allow_pickle=False) as arrays:
  packed,variance,colors=[arrays[k] for k in ['packed','variance','colors']]
 for index,observation in enumerate(record['observations']):
  spectra={int(i):independent_spectrum(packed[index,i].astype(float),variance[index,i].astype(float))
           for i in np.flatnonzero(colors[index]==1)}
  for direction in observation:
   a,b=direction['selection_phase'],direction['other_phase']
   fa,va,ua,window=spectra[a];fb,vb,ub,_=spectra[b]
   assert independent_bins(fa,va)==[p['bin_yx'] for p in direction['peaks']]
   ay,ax=divmod(a,2);by,bx=divmod(b,2)
   for peak in direction['peaks']:
    y,x=peak['bin_yx'];bins_checked+=1
    compare(abs(fa[y,x])**2/va[y,x],peak['selection_power'])
    compare(abs(fb[y,x])**2/vb[y,x],peak['other_phase_power'])
    alignment=np.exp(2j*np.pi*((by-ay)*np.fft.fftfreq(fa.shape[0])[y]/2+(bx-ax)*np.fft.fftfreq(fa.shape[1])[x]/2))
    compare(np.real(fa[y,x]*fb[y,x].conj()*alignment)/(abs(fa[y,x])*abs(fb[y,x])),peak['signed_principal_phase_agreement'])
    # Direct dense DFT row and covariance for B, including its fitted plane.
    yy,xx=np.indices(fb.shape)
    f=np.exp(-2j*np.pi*(yy.ravel()*y/fb.shape[0]+xx.ravel()*x/fb.shape[1]))/np.sqrt(fb.size)
    operator=(f-(f@ub)@ub.T)*window
    compare(operator@packed[index,b].ravel(),fb[y,x])
    compare(np.sum(abs(operator)**2*variance[index,b].ravel()),vb[y,x])
    direct_row_checks+=1

"""Describe the fixed CFA phase split; no calibrated detector or RGB output."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib

matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

REPO = Path("/home/dllu/proj/demosaic")
ROOT = REPO / ".cache/quality-20261107/V177-phase-frequency-holdout-v1"
EXTERNAL = Path("/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/V177-phase-frequency-holdout-v1")


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def ref(path):
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
    return {"path": str(Path(path).absolute()), "sha256": digest}


def stats(values):
    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)
    assert np.isfinite(values).all()
    return {
        "count": values.size,
        "mean": float(values.mean()),
        "median": float(np.median(values)),
        "p10": float(np.quantile(values, 0.1)),
        "p90": float(np.quantile(values, 0.9)),
        "minimum": float(values.min()),
        "maximum": float(values.max()),
    }


def main(output):
    result_path = EXTERNAL / "result-v1.json"
    result = read(result_path)
    plan = read(result["plan"]["path"])
    verification = ROOT / "independent-verification-v1.json"
    assert read(verification)["result"] == ref(result_path)
    assert read(verification)["status"].startswith("pass-independent-QR")
    template_path = Path(
        "/mnt/external/demosaic/quality-20261107/V176-template-information-v1/result-v1.json"
    )
    templates = {
        (r["step"], r["pair"]): r["windows"][-1]["known_template_SNR"]
        for r in read(template_path)["rows"]
        if r["phase_group"] == "green"
    }
    points = []
    for row in result["rows"]:
        primary = row["directions"][0]["peaks"][0]
        all_peaks = [p for d in row["directions"] for p in d["peaks"]]
        assert len(all_peaks) == 8
        points.append(
            {
                "step": row["step"],
                "pair": row["pair"],
                "member": row["member"],
                "fine_ladder": row["fine_ladder"],
                "conditional_template_SNR": templates[(row["step"], row["pair"])],
                "primary": primary,
                "maximum_other_phase_power_over8": max(p["other_phase_power"] for p in all_peaks),
                "counts_other_power_at_least": {
                    str(edge): sum(p["other_phase_power"] >= edge for p in all_peaks)
                    for edge in plan["descriptive_other_power_edges"]
                },
            }
        )
    groups = {}
    for member in ["present", "absent"]:
        selected = [p for p in points if p["member"] == member]
        original = [r for r in result["rows"] if r["member"] == member]
        peaks = [p for r in original for d in r["directions"] for p in d["peaks"]]
        assert len(selected) == 614 and len(peaks) == 4912
        edges = {}
        for edge in plan["descriptive_other_power_edges"]:
            passing = [p for p in peaks if p["other_phase_power"] >= edge]
            high_template = [p for p in selected if p["conditional_template_SNR"] >= 5]
            edges[str(edge)] = {
                "primary_cases": sum(p["primary"]["other_phase_power"] >= edge for p in selected),
                "any_of8_cases": sum(
                    p["maximum_other_phase_power_over8"] >= edge for p in selected
                ),
                "all_peaks": len(passing),
                "passing_peaks_clean_other_power_below1": sum(
                    p["clean_other_power"] < 1 for p in passing
                ),
                "passing_peaks_negative_principal_agreement": sum(
                    p["signed_principal_phase_agreement"] < 0 for p in passing
                ),
                "primary_high_conditional_SNR_cases": sum(
                    p["primary"]["other_phase_power"] >= edge for p in high_template
                ),
                "high_conditional_SNR_cases": len(high_template),
            }
        groups[member] = {
            "observations": 614,
            "peaks": 4912,
            "primary_selection_power": stats([p["primary"]["selection_power"] for p in selected]),
            "primary_other_phase_power": stats(
                [p["primary"]["other_phase_power"] for p in selected]
            ),
            "maximum_other_phase_power_over8": stats(
                [p["maximum_other_phase_power_over8"] for p in selected]
            ),
            "other_proxy_over_actual_variance": stats(
                [p["other_proxy_over_actual_variance"] for p in peaks]
            ),
            "descriptive_edges": edges,
        }
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    plt.rcParams.update({"font.size": 10, "axes.spines.top": False, "axes.spines.right": False})
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10.5, 4.5), layout="constrained")
    for member, color, label in [
        ("absent", "#888888", "Absent (614)"),
        ("present", "#227c83", "Present (614)"),
    ]:
        selected = [p for p in points if p["member"] == member]
